clips.title: The story
paras: Ragefire Chasm is a sprawling network of volcanic tunnels carved directly beneath Orgrimmar, accessible through the shadowy depths of the Cleft of Shadow. Despite being situated under the Horde's sovereign capital, these fiery caverns crawl with hostile troggs and a subversive coven of cultists loyal to the Shadow Council.

Beneath the stone streets and fortified towers of Orgrimmar lies Ragefire Chasm, a treacherous network of magma-filled subterranean caverns. The tunnels recently became overrun by the savage Ragefire troggs, who pushed upward from deep subterranean fissures. Magatha Grimtotem of the tauren attempted peaceful diplomacy with the creatures, but her overtures were violently rejected. Left unchecked, the troggs threaten to tunnel further into the foundations of the city itself.
